pictures.subject: backdrop
pictures.name: The farmhouse
pictures.prompt: Convert the entire image into a warm hand-painted storybook illustration rendered in soft gouache brushwork, seen from directly above, preserving every wall, room, doorway gap, and piece of furniture in exactly the same position, shape, and size as in the reference image. The flat-topped walls become aged timber-framed stone and plaster painted in muted warm greys with visible brushed texture, mossy mortar lines suggested by thin strokes of olive and umber rather than sharp pixel grids. The floor areas become worn wide-plank wooden boards in honey-amber and dusty sienna, with gentle grain strokes and the soft shadows of furniture legs pooling beneath each object. Each furniture piece — the iron-framed bed with its rumpled cream quilt top-left, the two wooden chests near it, the small side tables, the candle-lit centre table with its warm amber glow, the armchair and stacked crates in the middle-left room, the fireplace box with log stack, the single bed with straw-coloured mattress in the central room, the bookshelf and metal trunk bottom-left, the upholstered sofa, the crate and bench near the candle bottom-centre, the open shelving units and hanging garments top-right and mid-right, the wooden barrels, the desk with papers and safe box, the open crate of nails, the tin of preserved food with colourful vegetable tops — are repainted with the same gouache warmth: honey-brown wood with visible grain, cream and rust-ochre fabric, dull iron fittings, all softened by gentle ambient lighting as if a single lantern or two candles illuminate each room from within. Lit candles and the fireplace cast small warm cream-yellow glows onto nearby floors. The overall palette is rich but muted: warm greys, dusty taupes, amber, umber, sage, with no saturated primaries.

Rounded limestone boulders and rock outcrops keep their positions but gain warm stone colour, mossy ochre undersides and blue-white snow caps.
